<｜DSML｜parameter name="content" string="true">import { Response } from 'express';
import { asyncHandler } from '../utils/asyncHandler';
import * as userService from '../services/user.service';
import { AuthenticatedRequest } from '../middleware/auth';
import { Role } from '@prisma/client';

// 获取所有用户（仅管理员）
export const getAllUsers = asyncHandler(async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  // 检查用户角色是否为管理员
  if (req.user?.role !== Role.ADMIN) {
    res.status(403).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Only administrators can access user list',
    });
    return;
  }

  const users = await userService.getAllUsers();
  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    data: users,
  });
});

// 获取单个用户
export const getUser = asyncHandler(async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const userId = parseInt(req.params.id as string);
  if (isNaN(userId)) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid user ID',
    });
    return;
  }

  const user = await userService.getUserById(
    userId,
    req.user?.userId,
    req.user?.role as Role
  );

  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    data: user,
  });
});

// 更新用户信息
export const updateUser = asyncHandler(async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const userId = parseInt(req.params.id as string);
  if (isNaN(userId)) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid user ID',
    });
    return;
  }

  const { name, bio, avatar, role } = req.body;

  // 构建更新数据
  const updateData: userService.UpdateUserInput = {};
  if (name !== undefined) updateData.name = name;
  if (bio !== undefined) updateData.bio = bio;
  if (avatar !== undefined) updateData.avatar = avatar;
  if (role !== undefined) updateData.role = role;

  const updatedUser = await userService.updateUser(
    userId,
    updateData,
    req.user?.userId,
    req.user?.role as Role
  );

  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    data: updatedUser,
  });
});

// 修改密码
export const changePassword = asyncHandler(async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const userId = parseInt(req.params.id as string);
  if (isNaN(userId)) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid user ID',
    });
    return;
  }

  const { currentPassword, newPassword } = req.body;

  if (!currentPassword || !newPassword) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Current password and new password are required',
    });
    return;
  }

  const result = await userService.changePassword(
    userId,
    { currentPassword, newPassword },
    req.user?.userId,
    req.user?.role as Role
  );

  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    message: result.message,
  });
});

// 删除用户（仅管理员）
export const deleteUser = asyncHandler(async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const userId = parseInt(req.params.id as string);
  if (isNaN(userId)) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid user ID',
    });
    return;
  }

  // 检查用户角色是否为管理员
  if (req.user?.role !== Role.ADMIN) {
    res.status(403).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Only administrators can delete users',
    });
    return;
  }

  const result = await userService.deleteUser(userId, req.user?.role as Role);

  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    message: result.message,
  });
});

// 获取用户统计信息（仪表板）
export const getUserStats = asyncHandler(async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {
  const userId = parseInt(req.params.id as string);
  if (isNaN(userId)) {
    res.status(400).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'Invalid user ID',
    });
    return;
  }

  // 检查权限：用户只能查看自己的统计信息，管理员可以查看任何用户
  if (req.user?.role !== Role.ADMIN && req.user?.userId !== userId) {
    res.status(403).json({
      success: false,
      error: 'You can only view your own statistics',
    });
    return;
  }

  const stats = await userService.getUserStats(userId);
  res.status(200).json({
    success: true,
    data: stats,
  });
});</｜DSML｜parameter>
